**Have you attached the "Sim Troubleshooting Info" obtained from the program to this issue? Without this file, it is very unlikely that anything can be done to help you with this.**



**Have you attached the SimBuilderLog.txt from your SimRipper folder? This may be necessary especially if you were unable to obtain the troubleshooting info due to a crash.  You will need to obtain this right after the error happens and before using the program again.**



**Does this happen with all sims?**



**Does your sim appear incorrectly in the program? If so, please provide a screenshot of what the sim looks like in game vs in the program.**
